function.description: Read the linked Indexify account's position inside ONE stack. Use this after a trade settles to confirm the position, or when the user asks how a stack investment is doing. Returns the position's current value in USDC, total invested, cost basis, per-token amounts where the venue reports them, and the PnL block: realized, unrealized, and total profit/loss with percentages. A stack the account never bought returns zeros, not an error, so a zero row after a buy means the order has not settled yet — check it with indexify__orders_list. Read-only.
function.name: indexify__stack_holdings_get

stackId.description: The stack's own numeric id, as discovery, search, and order rows carry it. One stack per call.
